title: Verify signed generators of a three-ideal intersection

source.citation: Marco Aldi, Sergio Da Silva, and Daniele Grandini, Tensorial Constraints for Commuting Endomorphisms of the Generalized Tangent Bundle, arXiv:2604.15691

translation.notes: The complete N=6 Macaulay2 loop is translated directly. For all 64 signatures, mutual Groebner reduction proves that the proposed quadratic/cubic generators equal the intersection of the three signed linear ideals.
